Name: Ornitholigist Guild HHS Patch
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4][b]With permission from ivylovesbirds, I've uploaded a patch that makes the Ornithologist's Guild compatible with Rupnan's Heir-Hero-Spirit mod. [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]To install, delete the original maps folder located in [CP] Ornithologists Guild/assets/maps. Then download and install the maps folder included on this page instead. DO NOT SIMPLY OVERWRITE OR YOU WILL HAVE 2 GUILDS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This patch should also be compatible with SVE and the Ecology Superpack.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Enjoy![/b][/size]
